Scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别人：人们，“别人” means people other than a specified speaker or group; here the general group being told is “人们”. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别人：人们，别人 distinguishes other people from a particular speaker or group, but this narration needs the concrete group of people receiving Shennong’s information. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 别人：人们，别人 distinguishes other people from a relevant person, while this sentence means people in general who receive Shennong’s information. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs identify the misuse of “别人” and correctly replace it with “人们” for people in general.
